description: Preview which wallets in a batch (Solana or EVM) ran this analysis for this payer in the last 30 days: a hint, read with no network call; whether it comes from the history is decided when the charge is paid, by the movement measured then; every one still pays its share of the fee. This reveals a payer's own analysis history, so it needs the paying wallet's signed session; the MCP carries no session, so paid is always [] and the batch charges every destination. With each recipient's amount and a USD stablecoin token it also returns fee { amount (dollars, the analysis charge payout_batch would build), charged (destinations in it), belowMinimum (indexes of the lines below the minimum, which go without the paid analysis), minimum }. Returns { paid: string[], fee? }.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checks.description: The paid analysis tools, same as the batch.

payer.description: The paying wallet (base58 on Solana, 0x on EVM).

recipients.description: The destination wallets, same list as the batch.

amount.description: Human amount, as in payout_batch. Needed for fee.

token.description: The batch token address, same as the batch. Required on EVM; on Solana needed only for fee.

name: payout_reuse
